description: Per-term gradient liveness of the 12-term CFM loss cascade, read from the trainer's own _LAST_LOSS_TERMS side-channel after ONE real epoch. This is the measurement BLK-C12 asserted ('8 of 12 terms are exact zeros') but never produced: its status_basis read '待跑：逐项打印 loss 组成'.

arm_A_all_flags_on.purpose: proves every term's ACTIVE branch carries a gradient

arm_B_shipped_cfm_yaml.purpose: what the PRODUCTION config actually trains

arm_C_shipped_plus_weights_1.0.purpose: raw (unweighted) magnitude of the three dead generation-side terms

findings.C12_confirmed: Under the shipped configs/cfm.yaml exactly 8 of 12 terms are gradient-dead: diversity_term, shortcut_distill_loss, consistency_term, so3_term, edm_term, assemble_term, soft_valence_term, entropy_term. The claim is arithmetically correct.
findings.C12_misattributed: The zero terms are NOT missing engineering. All 12 branches are implemented and arm_A shows 12/12 live. Six of the eight are gated on a CONFIG VALUE that appears in ZERO config files (gen_validity_weight, assemble_loss_weight, mmd/repulsion, so3_average, edm_preconditioning); two are gated on a FLAG left off (shortcut-distill, consistency-weight).
findings.no_generation_objective_is_real: Of the 4 terms live under cfm.yaml, only bond_ce touches the decoded molecule's chemistry and it is a PER-EDGE cross-entropy. fm_term (13.31) trains the velocity field, w2 (0.082) and cb (0.00047) are regularisers. There is no molecule-level term, so BLK-C11 mode collapse has nothing to trade off against.

soft_valence_is_not_scale_invariant.cause: train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py:2377 sums valence_log_barrier() over every cloud in the batch with no division by n_clouds or n_atoms, and decoder_rework.py:499 returns excess.pow(2).sum() over atoms. The term is O(batch_size * n_atoms).
soft_valence_is_not_scale_invariant.consequence: No fixed weight in the YAML can be correct across cohorts. At weight 0.05 the tmQM cohort contributes ~6715 against a total live loss of ~15.6 — the term would swamp every other objective. This, not a missing wire-in, is why the term was never enabled.

assemble_has_nothing_to_act_on_for_tmqm.STATUS: still true, and it is the remaining live idea
assemble_has_nothing_to_act_on_for_tmqm.note: assemble_term penalises multi-fragment disconnection. tmQM complexes are single-fragment, so it reads 0 even at weight 1.0. Among the 8 dead terms it is the only one whose premise is untouched by the retraction — but it needs a multi-fragment cohort to act on, so it is not a fix for the tmQM runs either.

findings.entropy_is_scale_stable: entropy_term raw = -1.416 at weight 1.0 on tmQM vs -0.0158*100 = -1.58 at weight 0.01 in arm_A — the same order across a 8x cohort change, because it is an entropy of a fixed-width distribution, not a sum over atoms. Sign is negative as specified (the optimiser maximises entropy).

BLK_C11_root_cause_is_visible.STATUS: WITHDRAWN 2026-10-10 — the root cause it pointed to does not exist
BLK_C11_root_cause_is_visible.what_it_claimed: 0/2146 generated molecules were valence-invalid, so the soft-valence term (the only thing that could penalise that) being switched off was the visible cause of generation collapse.
BLK_C11_root_cause_is_visible.why_withdrawn: The 0/2146 came from cfm_property_panel.py calling a nonexistent RDKit API and swallowing the AttributeError. With the check fixed and metal caps measured from tmQM, the validity rate is 0.8495 — see metrics/by_metric/cfm_decode_chemistry_validity.json. There is no valence crisis for this term to fix.
BLK_C11_root_cause_is_visible.what_survives: The 12/12-vs-4/12 loss-term liveness measurement stands unchanged: the engineering is complete and the shipped config leaves 8 terms off, including both molecule-level ones. That is still true and still worth acting on — just not for the reason originally given.
